tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and end at H=0.48, more than 50 times shorter than the forecast horizon. The long-horizon probe tests whether the response reverses and constrains its magnitude where the forecast will be evaluated.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The leading candidate, but the pilot mainly constrains the ratio of slow amplitude to slow time constant, not their separate effects at H=24.6.
Can explain the positive short-window response but cannot reverse sign from the observed zero initial state.
Finer time resolution is less useful than longer horizon coverage for distinguishing slow adaptation from monotone saturation.
Does not constrain the slow response or test for reversal.
